sources.snippet: PIZDEC improves audit discipline; it does not make an AI agent infallible or replace specialist scanners and qualified human review. Results depend on authorization, accessible evidence, tool capabilities, model reasoning, target size, selected mode, and current vulnerability intelligence. Only audit assets you own or are authorized to assess.
